name: kimilm
description: Local AI agents on your own computer: chat, projects, memory, skills, plugins, harnesses and scheduled tasks. Models run on your machine.
author: Kiplabat Tarus

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:ui && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs --platform win && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:ui && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs --platform linux && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build:ui && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs --platform linux && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:ui && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && electron-builder --dir
